title: The Old House (The Tin Soldier's Gift)
summary: The antique house with carved gables and gargoyles stood solitary among modern mansions, holding within its quiet rooms an old gentleman who lived on memories of the past....
full_text:
The antique house with carved gables and gargoyles stood solitary among modern mansions, holding within its quiet rooms an old gentleman who lived on memories of the past.

A kind-hearted boy across the street gifted him a painted tin soldier to keep him company. In that warm parlor, filled with ancient books, smiling portraits, and the scent of dried rose leaves, the soldier stood faithful vigil, listening to tales of forgotten times.

Though the old gentleman eventually passed away and the house was pulled down, the seed of tenderness planted by the child's small gift lived on, reminding us that sympathy is the purest bridge across human solitude.
moral: A small gift of love offered across generations warms lonely hearts with eternal sunshine.
